parameters.query:
DECLARE @unidad NVARCHAR(10) = N'{{$json.unidad}}%';

;WITH f AS (
  SELECT
    db        = DB_NAME(database_id),
    type      = type_desc,                -- ROWS / LOG
    size_mb   = CONVERT(decimal(18,2), size/128.0),
    path      = physical_name
  FROM sys.master_files WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE physical_name LIKE @unidad       -- 🔑 filtra por C:% / E:% / S:%
)
SELECT TOP ({{ $json.top_n || 10 }})
  db, type, size_mb, path
FROM f
ORDER BY size_mb DESC;

-- Top-N bases por tamaño (global: suma todas las unidades)
;WITH files AS (
  SELECT
      database_id,
      type_desc,
      size_mb = CONVERT(decimal(18,2), size / 128.0),
      physical_name
  FROM sys.master_files WITH (NOLOCK)   -- sin filtro por unidad
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
      db          = DB_NAME(database_id),
      data_mb     = SUM(CASE WHEN type_desc = 'ROWS' THEN size_mb ELSE 0 END),
      log_mb      = SUM(CASE WHEN type_desc = 'LOG'  THEN size_mb ELSE 0 END),
      total_mb    = SUM(size_mb),
      sample_file = MIN(physical_name)
  FROM files
  GROUP BY database_id
)
SELECT TOP ({{ $json.top_n || 5 }})
    db,
    CAST(total_mb AS decimal(18,2)) AS size_mb,
    CAST(data_mb  AS decimal(18,2)) AS data_mb,
    CAST(log_mb   AS decimal(18,2)) AS log_mb,
    sample_file AS path
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_mb DESC;

SELECT TOP (50)       -- o 20 si prefieres
       DB_NAME(t.DatabaseID) AS DBName,
       t.StartTime,
       mf.physical_name,
       t.EventClass,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,2),(t.IntegerData*8.0)/1024.0) AS GrowthMB  -- MB
FROM fn_trace_gettable(
       (SELECT TOP 1 path FROM master.sys.traces WHERE is_default=1),
       DEFAULT
     ) AS t
LEFT JOIN master.sys.master_files AS mf
  ON mf.database_id = t.DatabaseID
 AND mf.name        = t.FileName
WHERE t.EventClass IN (92,93)
  AND t.StartTime >= DATEADD(DAY,-7,GETDATE())
ORDER BY t.StartTime DESC;

DECLARE @inst sysname = N'{{$node["Set - Params"].json["instance_name"]}}';

SELECT mi.instance_id,
       s.unidad,
       s.last_state,
       s.last_change_utc
FROM OpsObservability.dbo.monitoring_instance mi WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN OpsObservability.dbo.monitoring_disk_state s WITH (NOLOCK)
  ON s.instance_id = mi.instance_id
WHERE mi.instance_name = @inst;
